text:
Jess Lee: Quick heads up — Homeward agreed to a short customer story + hosted webinar (they're the regional logistics startup). Target launch Apr 10 (two weeks). Need interview + quote + legal sign-off. Are we good with timeline?

Samir Patel: Got it. Who's the primary contact at Homeward?

Jess Lee: Name: Priya Nair (Head of ML). priya@homeward.ai. She's ok with a 30m interview next Wed morning PST. Wants us to share questions in advance.

Elaine Wong: I'll take the interview Qs + transcript. Can someone add 3 bench metrics we want included? e.g., latency, cost-per-req, pass-rate.

Matt Rivers: I can pull a lightweight benchmark from the pilot logs — will share median p95 latency and avg token cost by EOD today. Any preferred format? table or bullet?

Claudia (Producer): Bullet + one visual (bar chart) good. Also want a short customer quote (1-2 lines) for the hero.

Jess Lee: Draft quote they gave in the kickoff: "Redwood cut our inference cost by ~40% while improving 99th percentile latency" — can legal sign off on that phrasing?

Legal Bot: Uploaded the NDA + quote sign-off flow: https://redwood.internal/legal/case-quote-flow. Please route final quote to legal@redwood.com with 'Homeward quote' in subject. If customer modifies wording, require explicit sign-off.

Samir Patel: Happy to handle the routing. I'll ask Priya to confirm the quote. Also any embargo/date constraints from their PR?

Elaine Wong: Interview Qs draft:
```
1) Quick overview of the problem and impact
2) Why Redwood vs alternatives
3) Any specific metric improvements? Can you share numbers?
4) How did rollout go — any gotchas?
5) Advice for teams trying to reproduce?
```

Matt Rivers: Bench numbers draft:
- Median latency: 85ms (token-level)
- 99th percentile latency: 220ms
- Cost per 1k tokens: $0.98 (after batching/quant)
I'll attach CSV in #dropbox.

Claudia (Producer): Proposed timeline:
- Today: gather bench + Qs
- Tue: interview + draft quote
- Wed: legal review
- Thu: design asset creation
- Apr 10: publish + webinar
Can we move interview to Tue morning to give legal a day?

Jess Lee: Can do Tue 10am PST. Samir, please confirm with Priya. I'll create the draft and tag legal when ready. @Elaine, use the transcript for pull quotes.

Legal Bot: :white_check_mark: Noted. We'll try to complete review within 24h after receiving the customer-approved quote. Please include a screenshot of the customer's email confirming wording to speed sign-off.

Samir Patel: Confirmed — Priya ok for Tue 10am PST. I'll forward calendar invite and include the draft quote in the invite for her to approve inline.

Claudia (Producer): One more ask — Webinar co-presenter? Priya offered to do 10-15 mins live demo. Would love an engineer from our side. @Matt you in?

Matt Rivers: Yes I can do live demo. I'll prep a 10-min run to show latency/cost dashboard.

Jess Lee: Awesome. Action items:
- Samir: confirm and route quote to legal (due Tue noon)
- Elaine: final Qs + transcript (due Tue afternoon)
- Matt: benchmark CSV + demo plan (due Wed)
- Claudia: design + webinar invite (due Thu)
I'll update deck in #launch-assets and follow up if blockers. :rocket:
